title: f120.9: E2E test — article relay delivery via mock SMTP peer
description:
End-to-end integration test: compose article via NNTP POST with email recipients, verify delivery via mock SMTP relay peer.

**What:** Tokio integration test that spins up a mock SMTP server (tokio TcpListener), configures SmtpRelayQueue with one peer pointing at it, POSTs an article, waits for delivery, and asserts the mock server received a valid SMTP transaction.

**Algorithm:**
1. In crates/smtp/tests/ or crates/integration-tests/, create relay_delivery_e2e.rs
2. Spawn mock SMTP server on 127.0.0.1:0 (OS-assigned port) using tokio::net::TcpListener:
   - Accept connection, read lines until QUIT
   - Assert received sequence: greeting 220, EHLO, AUTH PLAIN, MAIL FROM, RCPT TO, DATA, body, QUIT
   - Record each command
   - Respond with 250 OK to everything
3. Create SmtpRelayQueue with one peer pointing at mock server (plain TLS=false for test)
4. Call queue.enqueue(article_bytes, 'from@example.com', &['to@example.com'])
5. queue.drain_once_for_test() (expose a test-only method) or wait with timeout for queue to drain
6. Assert:
   - Mock server received AUTH PLAIN command (credentials sent)
   - Mock server received MAIL FROM:<from@example.com>
   - Mock server received RCPT TO:<to@example.com>
   - Mock server received DATA followed by article body and .\r\n terminator
   - Dot-stuffed lines handled correctly
   - Queue directory is empty after successful delivery
   - Relay metrics show success_count=1

**Defensive programming rules:**
- Use tokio::time::timeout to prevent test from hanging if delivery fails
- Test MUST NOT hard-code port numbers; use OS-assigned port via :0 binding
- Assert no credentials appear in test log output (capture logs in test)

**Tests (all within this bead's test file):**
- Test happy path: article delivered, queue empty (oracle: file system + mock server received commands)
- Test transient failure: mock server returns 451, article stays in queue (oracle: .env file still present)
- Test permanent failure: mock server returns 550, article moved to dead/ (oracle: dead/ directory has file)
- Test round-robin: two mock peers, send two articles, each peer receives one (oracle: both mock servers receive exactly one transaction)

**Acceptance:**
- cargo test -p usenet-ipfs-smtp -- relay_delivery_e2e passes (or wherever tests land)
- cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings passes
- Queue empty after success; dead/ populated after permanent failure
